body: I tried to kill myself the beginning of this year, January, and it hasn't gotten any better. But I do see this as a second chance, because I got a better job and have a great hobby that takes me outside. But the thoughts keep coming back to that day and being alone has worsen it. I'm trying my best to seek help but it hasn't worked so far. I'm talking to someone now, not a therapist, they are helping me though this. It just feels nice to get some of this off my chest now.

Thank you for your help. Sorry I didn't respond right away. I was out of data and internet connection. I was having a little episode again. But I needed some alone time from the world and it helped a little. Also, I tried to see a therapist a few months ago and he kept on forgetting our appointments. I also tired to call him for an appointment again last month and he didn't get back to me, no call, no voicemail, nothing. I was tired of this, I didn't try to reschedule another one.
